topic.title: Logging In to an Account
topic.shortdesc: Information about logging into to an existing account.

body.p: Go to the platform main page and look for the Log in option. This displays a log-in form. Follow the steps to complete the log-in process.
Various authentication options may be available, depending on how your administrator has configured the server, including username and password, and logging in with Google or GitHub.
body.note: When you log in with Google or GitHub, only reads your name and email address from the social account. No other data is collected.
